authenticity_review: The image exhibits severe structural artifacts that fundamentally compromise physical realism. The primary defect is the biological-mechanical fusion at the muzzle-bell interface: cow nasal tissue merges seamlessly into the open bells of the trumpets without any anatomical boundary or mechanical joint. This violates both biological integrity (tissue cannot merge with metal) and mechanical reality (no seal or connection mechanism exists). Additionally, the trumpets stand upright on their bells on soft grass with no visible support, violating basic physics—real brass instruments would tip over or sink into the ground when balanced this way. While individual textures (fur, lacquered brass) are rendered with high fidelity, these composite-level failures represent fundamental generation errors rather than minor anomalies. The depth map statistics (mean=5.19, std=5.23) suggest reasonable scene depth but cannot capture these interface-level fusion artifacts.
